## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Club Booking
where: RinkService (uses), src/business/rinkService.ts, component business

response.rationale: RinkService keeps the two apart. Club bookings are created through ClubBookingRepository.create with date, start, end and halves, which looks like a club reserving all or part of the rink for a time slot. Booking is handled by a separate BookingRepository, whose methods (listBySession, listByMembership, groupBySession) are used in the session hold, purchase, payment, expiry and free-entry flows. That makes Booking look like an individual's booking for a session. The two share only the word "booking" and some time-related fields, so they are different concepts.
